name.ja: ニールス・ヘンリック・アーベル

overview.en: Niels Henrik Abel was a Norwegian mathematician who proved the impossibility of solving the general quintic equation algebraically and made groundbreaking contributions to elliptic functions.

early_life.en: Abel was born in Nedstrand, Norway, to a poor family. His mathematical talent was recognized by his teacher Bernt Michael Holmboe, who supported his studies.

impact.en: Abel's proof of the unsolvability of the quintic equation was a landmark in algebra. His work on elliptic functions and Abelian integrals opened vast new areas of mathematics. He died of tuberculosis at 26.

event.en: Proved impossibility of solving the general quintic
Published memoir on a general property of a class of transcendental functions

title.en: Proof of the Impossibility of Algebraic Solution of General Equations

description.en: Demonstrated that no general algebraic solution exists for polynomials of degree five or higher

text.en: He has left mathematicians something to keep them busy for five hundred years.
